Greater Dragonmark (Mark Of Sentinel): Can use Globe Of Invulnerability once per day as a spell-like ability
Improved Greater Dragonmark: Can use a previously-chosen level 3 dragonmark spell-like ability 2 times per day or choose another to use once per day
Improved Least Dragonmark: Can use a previously-chosen level 1 dragonmark spell-like ability 2 times per day or choose another to use once per day
Improved Lesser Dragonmark: Can use a previously-chosen level 2 dragonmark spell-like ability 2 times per day or choose another to use once per day
